author: cl-vtpush
body:
[opus 5.5] Delivered on main: ad46890a (seed re-reads threads the cache is short of; an answer from the server's copy is never presented as complete when messages may be missing), 0207f08e (agentctl chat bridge event sinks), 19d6c70d (vibe-talk applies a bridge's own post and reaction records at once; the records adapter waits for vibe-talk at startup). Gates: validate OK, 118/118 and 138/138.

Root cause of the partial thread (case study, thread 1793377304.077519 on 2026-10-30): an ingest bug. After a restart, the poller's seed took every thread as read to its root's latest reply without reading any reply. Three bridge replies that rate-limited reads had never fetched were skipped, and the reply posted after the seed reached the page alone.

Still open, for these reasons:
- Deploy and the live check: vibe-talk and agentctl from 19d6c70d, plus event-sinks.json for each bridge that posts into a vibe-talk channel.
- Reactions by anyone but a bridge with a sink (the owner's own included) still appear only through the poller. The owner tail's reaction records wake it, but they are not applied directly; no sample of their shape was available to parse.
- The page shows the server's incomplete mark only when as_of is more than two minutes old. A younger gap needs a page change (page frozen for #624 voice-page-modularity).
